feeds.title: Spectrum Magazine
feeds.description: SpectrumMagazine.org is the online companion to Spectrum, a journal established to encourage Seventh-day Adventist participation in the discussion of contemporary issues from a Christian viewpoint, to look without prejudice at all sides of a subject, to evaluate the merits of diverse views, and to foster intellectual and cultural growth. Follow us to find the latest news, columns, spiritual reflections, Sabbath School commentary, and interviews.

feeds.title: Adventist Today
feeds.description: Adventist Today (AT) is an independent journalism ministry serving the global Adventist community and readers interested in a reliable source of information about the Adventist faith and institutions.

feeds.title: Adventist Record
feeds.description: Adventist Record is the official news and lifestyle magazine for the South Pacific Division of the Seventh-day Adventist Church. Here you will find information on Adventist faith, health, community and culture.

feeds.title: BarelyAdventist
feeds.description: BarelyAdventist is a satire and humor blog on Adventist culture and issues. It is written by committed Adventists that have no interest in tearing down the church. The whole point is to help the Adventist faith community grow through conversation and humor in a way that does not involve over-earnest soap boxing or angry rants.

feeds.title: Emmanuel-Brinklow Seventh-day Adventist Church
feeds.description: Emmanuel-Brinklow Seventh-day Adventist Church, stands as a testimony to the miraculous blessings of God. All praise, honor and glory be to God for His leading in the birth and growth of this church. Follow this blog to find more information on how to transform the world through empowered disciples.

feeds.title: Melbourne City Adventist Church Blog
feeds.description: An inner urban, Melbourne Adventist Church community, who enjoy connection with God and each other. We exist to create a safe place where individuals can explore a Christ-centred worldview.

feeds.title: Renton Seventh-day Adventist Church Blog
feeds.description: Renton Seventh-day Adventist Church, is an actively growing church that represents more than 15 countries, so no matter where you're from, you're welcome.

feeds.title: Orchard City Notes
feeds.description: The Orchard City SDA Church is a small Seventh-day Adventist church located in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. Our Mission is to make friends and share with them the good news for these last days.

feeds.title: Adventist Media Response and Conversation
feeds.description: News, information and opinion on subjects of interest to Adventists.

feeds.title: Liberal Adventist Pastor
feeds.description: Commentary on the life and work of Adventist pastors by an old, White, liberal Adventist pastor. Most of these posts are sermon manuscripts.

feeds.title: Theotokos
feeds.description: Discussing Seventh-day Adventism from a Catholic and biblical perspective, and then just some other stuff too. Here we attempt to show the biblical basis for Christianity's abandonment of the Old Testament sabbath, the biblical basis for Sunday observance, and takes a look at other pertinent topics relating to Adventism and Catholicism.

feeds.title: From Seventh-day Adventism to Catholicism
feeds.description: Discussions of a Former Seventh-Day Who Discovered the Truth About Catholicism by Teresa Beem.

feeds.title: Cambridge Seventh-day Adventist Church Blog
feeds.description: Cambridge SDA Church is a welcoming, spiritual community whose purpose is to serve as witness for our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Join us on this journey that reveals the heart of God and renews us all.

feeds.title: Dakota Adventist Academy Blog
feeds.description: Dakota Adventist Academy (DAA) cultivates a Seventh-day Adventist, Christ-centered life by providing academic and vocational education preparing young people for commitment to God, service to society, and citizenship in heaven.

feeds.title: Adventist Activism
feeds.description: This blog is for Adventists attempting to embody God's love for the world through advocacy, volunteerism and other humanitarian adventures. Follow this blog for collection of our stories and thoughts regarding this work of spiritually-motivated social action.

feeds.title: Exsdapastors
feeds.description: Ben McPhaull is a pastor, speaker and trainer who captures audiences with his compelling testimony and Gospel-centered preaching. This is a place to find support as you study the Word and encouragement to live with integrity on the path God has for you. Here you will find links to books, websites, audio and video that will speak to your situation as an Adventist pastor.

feeds.title: SDA Reform Movement
feeds.description: The SDARM Church is a worldwide religious organization based on the teachings of the Bible. We organized in 1925 and are now in over 100 countries around the world. We encourage you to learn more about the outreach and ministries at SDARM, and our beliefs.

feeds.title: Adventist Review
feeds.description: The flagship journal of the Seventh-day Adventist Church and the longest running religious journal in America. The purposes and mission of the journal to inform, educate, and inspire the denomination it serves.

feeds.title: Reinder Bruinsma
feeds.description: Reinder Bruinsma served as the interim-president of the Adventist Church in Belgium and Luxembourg. Find his preachings, lectures and writings here.

feeds.title: Croydon Seventh-day Adventist Church
feeds.description: Croydon SDA Church is a body of people from all walks of life who are being transformed by Jesus Christ. We are dedicated to using every means possible to proclaim God's final message of hope and warning to the world. We encourage you to explore our blog. Each is filled with trustworthy, eye-opening information backed by Scripture that will totally transform the way you think about God.

feeds.title: Sacramento Central Seventh-day Adventist Church
feeds.description: Proclaiming the everlasting gospel to all the world. Here you will find weekly devotional thoughts that are designed to encourage you to make your petitions known unto God with thanksgiving.

feeds.title: Adventist Defense League Blog
feeds.description: The Adventist Defense League is dedicated to defending and responding to alleged arguments that critics think can successfully destroy our Adventist positions. Join us as we faithfully and objectively present to you both sides of the issue, and let you decide the truth.

feeds.title: Takoma Park SDA Church
feeds.description: We are a welcoming and diverse community that is united in following Jesus to love and serve. We are a place where you will always be greeted with a smile. Here you will find exactly what your soul needs every Sabbath with us! Follow us to stay up to date on our latest news and events!

feeds.title: Dr. Jesse Wilson Blog
feeds.description: Jesse Wilson, is an exceptional communicator, pastor trainer, professor and evangelist. He is a gifted clinician providing countless churches, leadership teams, and ministry conferences with cutting edge insights on pastoral leadership, and evangelism and church growth. He is passionate about kingdom building and building leaders who build the kingdom. This passion coupled with an undying passion to know the heart of God pushes him to write, teach and preach with power.

feeds.title: East-Central Africa Division
feeds.description: This blog is a sub-entity of the General Conference of Seventh-day Adventists, which oversees the Church's work in East-Central Africa region in the areas of digital multimedia and technical Evangelism. Learn more about Adventist beliefs and our world-wide organizational structure.
